CustomField.description: Whether Rogo may use the customer's name, logo, or marks for marketing / publicity / commercial purposes. "Yes" = unconditionally permitted. "With Conditions" = permitted but restricted (e.g. prior consent required, logo only, opt-out). "No" = expressly prohibited. "Not Mentioned" = no publicity / logo / marketing clause anywhere in the documents. The verbatim clause is in Logo_Publicity_Language__c.
CustomField.label: Logo / Publicity Rights
